items.title: I'm a board certified DJ for my college radio station - AMA!
items.author: ughitsrose
items.body:
Hi everyone!

I literally just got board certified yesterday for my college radio station, and I thought a great way to celebrate would be doing an AMA because I love talking about my station and what I do. The only thing I will not answer is what station I work at because that would reveal where I live/go to school. But outside of that feel free to AMA!

items.title: En drept og elleve såret i nytt angrep mot flyplassen i Riyadh
items.body: Minst én person er bekreftet drept og elleve andre såret i et nytt angrep mot den internasjonale flyplassen i Saudi-Arabias hovedstad Riyadh.
